Title: Ungated Public Preview: Azure API Center

Body.Content:
We're thrilled to share that Azure API Center is now open for everyone to try during our ungated public preview! Azure API Center is a new Azure service that is part of the Azure API Management platform. It is the central hub where you can effortlessly keep track of all your APIs company-wide, making them readily discoverable, reusable, and manageable. Click here to learn more about Azure API Center.

During this ungated public preview phase, you can take advantage of the following capabilities:

  • Create an Azure API Center service 

  • Register new APIs into your API Center 

  • View, create, edit, or delete API versions and associate API versions with environments 

  • Define and manage custom metadata schema for your APIs 

  • Browse, filter and search APIs based on their metadata in the Azure Portal
